inspiration.observed_pattern: Two parenthesized ordered and limited SELECT operands feed an INTERSECT result.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one independently authored duplicate-free label in common, one local LIMIT per branch, and one outer LIMIT; the new schema and values isolate operand-local paging from the source tutorial.

fixture_notes: The first two rows from each branch are alpha and beta; the outer LIMIT returns only alpha after the two bounded operands are intersected.
determinism_notes: Fixed rank values, unique row IDs, explicit branch ordering, and explicit outer ordering make the one-row result deterministic.
setup: CREATE TABLE requested_labels_min (row_id INT PRIMARY KEY, label VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, rank_no INT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE approved_labels_min (row_id INT PRIMARY KEY, label VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, rank_no INT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: (SELECT label FROM requested_labels_min ORDER BY rank_no ASC LIMIT 2) INTERSECT ALL (SELECT label FROM approved_labels_min ORDER BY rank_no ASC LIMIT 2) ORDER BY label ASC LIMIT 1

checks.sql: SELECT row_id, label, rank_no FROM requested_labels_min ORDER BY row_id
SELECT row_id, label, rank_no FROM approved_labels_min ORDER BY row_id
